claims.assertion: Swaruu Minerva said ascension may shift carbon-based DNA toward more complex proto-silicon unlike terrestrial silicon.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)

claims.assertion: Swaruu Minerva reported increasingly crystalline DNA across human, Taygetan, and Swaruunian samples, with differing chromosome and strand counts.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)
claims.qualifiers: She described three samples, not superiority.

claims.assertion: Swaruu Minerva said silicon-based organisms can differ and silicon alone does not imply greater consciousness.
claims.speaker: Swaruu Minerva (11)
claims.qualifiers: She distinguished crystalline from noncrystalline forms.

coverage_gaps: physical capabilities attributed to crystalline DNA
